intro:
One. That's how many Hyundai Ioniq 9s were sold in the whole of Australia in September 2026 – and 79 models sold zero. Here are 12 new cars Australians just aren't buying right now, from the Volkswagen ID.4 and Mazda CX-70 to the Polestar 3, Jeep Wrangler, Fiat 500 and Peugeot 308 – with the real sales numbers, the price cuts dealers are using to move them, and the cars that only LOOK like flops.

All monthly figures are VFACTS September 2026 data, published through CarExpert's new-car sales database. Only cars still on sale made the list.
